name: ASUS PRIME A620AM-K AMD A620A Socket AM5 DDR5 Micro-ATX Motherboard
shortDescription: ASUS PRIME A620AM-K AMD A620A Socket AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard (Supports AMD Ryzen 9000 / 8000 / 7000 Series Processors Up to 120W CPU / 2 x DDR5 DIMM Max 128GB Up to 7600+ MT/s OC / PCIe 4.0 x16 Slot / PCIe 4.0 M.2 NVMe
descriptionHtml:
ASUS PRIME A620AM-K AMD A620A Socket AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard (Supports AMD Ryzen 9000 / 8000 / 7000 Series Processors Up to 120W CPU / 2 x DDR5 DIMM Max 128GB Up to 7600+ MT/s OC / PCIe 4.0 x16 Slot / PCIe 4.0 M.2 NVMe Slot / DisplayPort 1.4 & HDMI 2.1 Outputs / Realtek 1Gb Ethernet / 5X Protection III / Aura Sync Addressable RGB Headers / Official 1-Year Local Agent Warranty)

Build a high-performance AMD AM5 desktop rig with the ASUS PRIME A620AM-K Micro-ATX Motherboard, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by an official 1-Year agent warranty. Designed on the AMD A620A chipset, this motherboard seamlessly supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series desktop processors up to 120W TDP. Equipped with dual DDR5 DIMM slots supporting memory overclocking up to 7600+ MT/s with AMD EXPO, a high-speed PCIe 4.0 x16 graphics slot, a PCIe 4.0 M.2 SSD slot, dual display connectivity via DisplayPort 1.4 and HDMI 2.1, robust 5X Protection III hardware safeguards, and Aura Sync RGB headers for customizable lighting.
